title: 2026 Lexus IS 500 F Sport Performance vs 2026 BMW M3
text:
# 2026 Lexus IS 500 F Sport Performance vs 2026 BMW M3

The 2026 Lexus IS 500 makes 472 hp from its 5.0-liter V-8.

The 2026 BMW M3 Competition xDrive makes 503 hp from a twin-turbo inline-six.

The IS 500 reached 60 mph in 4.4 seconds; the M3 Competition xDrive in 3.4 seconds.
